title: Karen Gallaudet's remote viewing training with Paul Smith

tellings.quote: Karen has taken one basic course and then she just finished the advanced course she actually went to his place in in Cedar City Utah

plain: Karen Gallaudet, the wife of a retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet, has been trained in remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe distant places or hidden things using only the mind, by a teacher named Paul Smith. Tim Gallaudet says she took one basic course and then finished the advanced course, traveling to Smith's place in Cedar City, Utah for it, sometime in the last couple of years. He tells it as something close to home that shows his family takes the practice seriously.
